quests.title: Through the Pool
text: The pool you ringed with flowers is shimmering. Step in and wake in the Twilight Forest, the spirits' own realm, under its endless dusk.

tasks.title: Step through the shimmering pool into the Twilight Forest

quests.title: Lanterns of the Dusk
text: The dusk never lifts, and a camp needs light. Walk into a Firefly Forest and catch fireflies and cicadas in jars to light your first camp.

tasks.title: Catch fireflies in jars to light your camp
Catch cicadas in jars to light your camp

quests.title: The Wary Raven
text: Forest ravens take flight at the slightest noise. Sneak up and take a raven feather, the key ingredient of the realm's maps.

tasks.title: Find the quiet forest where ravens roost
Take raven feathers without startling the flock

quests.title: A Map That Draws Itself
text: The forest hides its own roads. Bind a raven feather, torchberries and glowstone into a Magic Map Focus, then a Magic Map that charts biomes and marks every landmark around the portal.

tasks.title: Craft a Magic Map that draws itself

quests.title: Atlas of the Twilight
text: The map shows which lands are still veiled by curses. Set foot in the Enchanted Forest, the Mushroom Forest, the Spooky Forest and the Oak Savannah to chart them.

quests.title: Inside the Hollow Hill
text: A grassy mound hides a cavern full of ores, spider spawners and redcaps. Break in, raid its chests and come out with steeleaf.

tasks.title: Raid the hill's chests for steeleaf

quests.title: Leaf-Steel
text: Steeleaf is the realm's first native metal, and gear that grows enchantments of its own. Forge a steeleaf pickaxe or chestplate.

quests.title: The Serpent's Court
text: The magic map shows a walled courtyard of nagastone. Find it and scout its broken pillars before the guardian wakes.

tasks.title: Find the Naga Courtyard on the map
Watch the Naga coil among its pillars

quests.title: Coils of the Naga
text: The Naga charges in loops through the courtyard. Dodge its rushes and strike its segments until it falls, lifting the first curse.

tasks.title: Defeat the Naga to lift the first curse

quests.title: Scales of the Serpent
text: The Naga's scales make armour that shrugs off knockback. Turn them into a chestplate and leggings.

quests.title: The Questing Ram
text: In a ring of stone in the Quest Grove grazes the Questing Ram, who wants wool of all sixteen colours. Feed it one of each and see what it leaves behind.

tasks.title: Find the Questing Ram in its grove
Feed the ram light blue wool
Feed the ram light gray wool

quests.title: Living Iron
text: Ironwood grows from the forest floor. Dig liveroot, craft it with iron and gold into raw ironwood, and smelt ironwood ingots.

tasks.title: Dig liveroot from the forest floor
Craft raw ironwood with iron and gold

quests.title: Ironwood Arsenal
text: A Spartan smith's pattern takes ironwood well. Craft an ironwood weapon: a glaive, katana or halberd.

quests.title: The Glowing Spire
text: A giant mushroom tower rises in the Mushroom Forest. Find the way up through its caps and stems to the loot at the top.

tasks.title: Climb the caps and stems to the top

quests.title: Thorns in the Hedge
text: Hedge spiders lurk in the Hedge Maze's walls. Reach the chests at its centre and get back out within ten minutes, before the spiders swarm.

lines: The walls are crawling. Reach the centre quickly.

tasks.title: Fight through the hedge spiders before the swarm closes in

search.found: A chest at the maze's heart.

tasks.title: Open the chests at the maze's centre

quests.title: The Lich's Spire
text: With the Naga gone the Lich Tower opens. Climb its winding stairs and painting rooms, past skeleton druids and the tower's spawners.

tasks.title: Fight past the tower's skeleton druids

quests.title: Shields of the Lich
text: The Lich hides behind spinning shields and clones. Break the shields with ranged blows, ignore the copies, and end it at the tower's crown.

tasks.title: Defeat the Lich at the tower's crown

quests.title: The Lich's Sceptres
text: Among the Lich's treasures lie four sceptres. Claim one and use it in battle against the undead.

search.found: A sceptre in the Lich's treasure.

tasks.title: Claim a sceptre from the Lich's treasures
Test the sceptre against the dead

quests.title: The Choking Swamp
text: The Lich's fall clears the fog over the Swamp, but mosquito swarms and hunger still haunt it. Cross it in search of the labyrinth.

tasks.title: Beat off the swarm that haunts the swamp

quests.title: Map of the Maze
text: The labyrinth lies underground. Upgrade your Magic Map Focus into a Maze Map Focus and craft a Maze Map that traces corridors below.

tasks.title: Upgrade your focus to trace corridors

quests.title: Halls of the Labyrinth
text: Below the swamp sprawls the Labyrinth, with maze slimes and trapped vaults. Map it and find the Mazebreaker Pickaxe or Ore Magnet in its vaults.

tasks.title: Find the entrance to the labyrinth
Clear the maze slimes from the halls

search.found: A trapped vault gives up its prize.

quests.title: Horns in the Dark
text: Minotaurs pace the labyrinth halls. Bring down five and take a Minotaur axe from them.

quests.title: The Minoshroom
text: At the labyrinth's heart waits the Minoshroom, charging with its diamond axe. Bait its charge into walls and finish it.

tasks.title: Defeat the Minoshroom at the labyrinth's heart

quests.title: Meef Stroganoff
text: The Minoshroom's meef stroganoff is a Twilight classic. Taste it, then hunt raw meef from minotaurs and cook enough for your next trip.

tasks.title: Cook meef stroganoff for the road

quests.title: Unmaking Things
text: Old gear can be unmade. Build an Uncrafting Table and break down an old enchanted item into its parts.

tasks.title: Break down an old enchanted item into its parts

quests.title: Three Trophies
text: The first part of the spirits' realm is free. Gather the Naga, Lich and Minoshroom trophies as proof.

quests.title: Back to the Dusk
text: The forest calls again. The Minoshroom's death has cleared the Fire Swamp's smoke, and the Dark Forest has begun to stir.

tasks.title: Find the Fire Swamp the clearing smoke reveals

quests.title: Through the Fire Swamp
text: Fire jets and lava pools fill the Fire Swamp. Brew fire resistance and push through to the Hydra's lair.

tasks.title: Brew fire resistance to cross the fire jets

quests.title: The Hydra's Lair
text: Find the lair cut into the swamp's hill, and the Hydra waiting inside.

tasks.title: Find the lair cut into the swamp's hill

quests.title: Three Heads Burning
text: The Hydra spits fire and mortars. Strike its heads when they open, before they regrow, until the body falls.

tasks.title: Defeat the Hydra in its lair

quests.title: Fire in the Metal
text: Combine fiery blood with iron to forge fiery ingots, the hottest metal of the realm.

quests.title: Under the Black Canopy
text: The Dark Forest is lit by nothing. Brave its blindness and the goblins, redcaps and hostile wolves that roam it.

tasks.title: Fight off what hunts in the dark

quests.title: Seeds of Wonder
text: Rare saplings of the Tree of Time, Tree of Transformation, Miner's Tree and Sorting Tree hide in the Dark Forest. Grow one and set its heart working.

tasks.title: Take a rare sapling from the Dark Forest
Plant it and set its heart working

quests.title: The Phantom Stronghold
text: Beneath the Dark Forest lies the Knight Stronghold. Find the trapdoor in, past goblin knights and helmet crabs.

tasks.title: Find the trapdoor into the Knight Stronghold

quests.title: Shards of Armour
text: Collect armour shards from goblin knights and the stronghold's chests and press them into knightmetal ingots.

tasks.title: Collect armour shards from the knights and chests
Press the shards into knightmetal ingots

quests.title: Six Phantom Knights
text: In the stronghold's throne room six Knight Phantoms rise one after another. Outlast them all.

tasks.title: Outlast all six Knight Phantoms in the throne room

quests.title: Block and Chain
text: The phantoms' metal was made for heavy weapons. Craft a Block and Chain or a Knightmetal Shield.

tasks.title: Craft a Block and Chain from knightmetal

quests.title: Knightly Arms
text: Use knightmetal for a Spartan weapon: a knightmetal longsword, lance or warhammer.

quests.title: The Dark Tower
text: At the Dark Forest's centre stands a towerwood spire. Climb past towerwood borers, ghastguards and carminite golems, triggering the builder blocks to climb.

tasks.title: Find the towerwood spire at the Dark Forest's centre
Fight the towerwood borers on the way up

quests.title: Carminite Hearts
text: Harvest carminite from ghastlings and golems and destroy the carminite reactors that keep the tower's defences alive.

tasks.title: Harvest carminite from the ghastlings and golems
Destroy a carminite reactor and take its core

quests.title: Tears of the Ur-Ghast
text: Atop the tower the Ur-Ghast cries fire. Break the reactors when it retreats, then strike it down.

tasks.title: Strike down the Ur-Ghast atop the tower

quests.title: The Fiery Set
text: With fiery tears and blood, finish a full suit of fiery armour or a fiery sword and pickaxe.

quests.title: Weapons of Flame
text: Forge a fiery Spartan weapon, a greatsword, scythe or heavy crossbow that sets enemies alight.

quests.title: Six Trophies
text: The forest's middle lands are free. Add the Hydra, Knight Phantom and Ur-Ghast trophies to your hall.

quests.title: The Cold Reaches
text: The forest's snowy forest has opened. Cross it through blizzards, winter wolves and falling ice.

tasks.title: Fight off the winter wolf that hunts the pass

quests.title: Caves of the Yeti
text: Find the yeti cave in the snowy forest and hunt yetis for arctic fur.

tasks.title: Take arctic fur from the yetis

quests.title: The Alpha Yeti
text: The Alpha Yeti hurls ice and roars the ceiling down. Wait for it to tire, then strike.

tasks.title: Defeat the Alpha Yeti in its cave

quests.title: Armour of Fur
text: Sew arctic fur into arctic armour that can be dyed and keeps the cold out.

quests.title: The Aurora Palace
text: On the Glacier stands the Aurora Palace of ice. Climb its halls past snow guardians and ice cores to the queen's chamber.

tasks.title: Find the Aurora Palace on the Glacier
Fight past the palace's snow guardians

quests.title: The Snow Queen
text: The Snow Queen summons ice shields and hammers you from above. Break her guard and bring her down.

tasks.title: Break the Snow Queen's guard and bring her down

quests.title: Caves of the Trolls
text: The Highlands open at last. Search the troll caves under them for trollsteinn and the vault holding the Lamp of Cinders.

tasks.title: Find the troll caves under the Highlands

search.found: A lamp that burns without oil, in the troll vault.

tasks.title: Open the vault holding the Lamp of Cinders

quests.title: Burn the Thorns
text: The Lamp of Cinders burns away the thorns of the Thornlands. Carve a path to the Final Plateau.

tasks.title: Burn a path through the Thornlands
Carve the path on to the Final Plateau

quests.title: The Unfinished Castle
text: On the plateau stands the final castle, sealed behind force fields and still unfinished. Reach its gate and see what waits for the realm next.

quests.title: A Hall of Trophies
text: Build a hall in your base and mount all eight trophies on pedestals: Naga, Lich, Minoshroom, Hydra, Knight Phantom, Ur-Ghast, Alpha Yeti and Snow Queen.

tasks.title: Mount all eight trophies in a hall of your own
